**Two‑Person Vegetarian Cheesy Penne**

> A quick, comforting dish that pairs perfectly with a crisp green salad or crusty bread.  
> **Serves:** 2 | **Prep Time:** ~10 min | **Cook Time:** ~20 min  

---

### Ingredients

| Item | Quantity |
|------|----------|
| Penne pasta (or your favorite short shape) | 200 g (≈½ lb) |
| Olive oil | 2 Tbsp |
| Small yellow onion | 1, finely diced |
| Garlic cloves | 2, minced |
| Canned whole peeled tomatoes (crushed) | 400 g (14 oz) |
| Water / vegetable broth | ¼ cup (optional, for thinning) |
| Sea salt | To taste |
| Ground black pepper | To taste |
| Sugar (to balance acidity) | pinch |
| Red chili flakes | ⅛ tsp (optional) |
| Heavy cream *or* unsweetened oat milk | 50 mL (about ¾ Tbsp) |
| Shredded mozzarella (low-moisture) | 80 g (≈¾ cup) |
| Grated Parmigiano–Reggiano | 30 g (≈¼ cup) |
| Fresh basil leaves | handful, torn |
| Lemon zest (for brightness) | ½ tsp |

*(Feel free to swap mozzarella/cheddar for a dairy-free blend if desired.)*

---

### Instructions

#### 1️⃣ Prep the Base  
1. Bring a pot of salted water to boil. Toss in the penne and cook “al dente” according to package instructions (~11 min). Drain, reserving about ¼ cup of pasta water. Set aside.

#### 2️⃣ Build the Sauce  
1. While the pasta cooks, heat the olive oil over medium heat in a wide skillet.  
2. Add the diced onion; sauté until translucent, ≈4 minutes.  
3. Stir in the minced garlic and chili flakes—cook just until fragrant, 30 seconds.  
4. Pour in the crushed tomatoes (and a splash of reserved pasta water if you prefer a thinner consistency). Season with sea salt, pepper, and a pinch of sugar. Let it simmer gently for 12–15 minutes, stirring occasionally, so flavors meld.

#### 3️⃣ Finish With Cream & Cheese  
1. Reduce the heat to low. Swirl in the cream (or oat milk), then fold in the shredded mozzarella. Allow the mixture to bubble slightly until the cheese melts into a silky coating.  
2. Sprinkle half of the Parmigiano–Reggiano on top, letting it melt through as well. Taste and adjust seasoning if necessary.

#### 4️⃣ Combine & Serve  
1. Return the drained penne to the pan, tossing vigorously to coat each strand evenly. If the sauce feels too thick, drizzle in some reserved pasta water until you reach your preferred consistency.  
2. Remove from heat, stir in the torn basil leaves and lemon zest for freshness.  
3. Plate immediately onto warmed bowls or plates. Top with the remaining Parmigiano–Reggiano and a few extra basil leaves for garnish.

---

### Tips & Variations

| Idea | How It Works |
|------|--------------|
| **Add veggies** | Throw in sliced zucchini, spinach, or cherry tomatoes during step 2 for color and nutrition. |
| **Make it creamy** | Replace the heavy cream with coconut milk or cashew cream for a richer texture without dairy. |
| **Cheese swap** | Try provolone, fontina, or a smoked gouda for different flavor profiles. |
| **Herb boost** | Swap basil for oregano or thyme when making a more traditional marinara base. |
| **Sidekick** | Pair with a mixed greens salad tossed in balsamic vinaigrette or a warm baguette slice brushed with garlic butter. |

Enjoy this hearty yet light meal that’s ready in under 30 minutes! Buon appetito!
